test_title: PYST 27: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - Reasoning (Held On: 20th Sep 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Statements: All cars are trucks. Some trucks have wheels.

Conclusions:

I. Some wheels are cars.

II. All trucks are wheels.
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ef2afd80ee9943d234dd05452595761ee347e0a029784dab5753e809a41dbb66.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some wheels are cars. → Does not follow (As all cars are trucks and some trucks have wheels. So it is possible but not definite.)

II. All trucks are wheels. → Does not follow (As all cars are trucks and some trucks have wheels. So it is possible but not definite.)

∴ Here, Neither follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
